services.name: Adult MMA
services.desc: If you asked me what’s the most important martial art to begin learning as a starting point for self defense? Without hesitation I’d say boxing! Why? The secret is in the movement, footwork and timing. These are attributes you develop through boxing and kickboxing training (and also in our Kali / Filipino weapon training and JKD). What you find out is that if someone attacks you and you try to hit them back, they won’t just stand there and let you. Who Knew! Before you can use any other cool techniques you’ll learn, you first need to be able to move! Kensho’s curriculum starts with boxing and kickboxing movement and footwork to get our students rocking in a hurry. After just a few classes,
